name: MJUC
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: values are 0-1 positions, read through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.

Ratio, make-up and mix carry. Compress is a drive amount (not a threshold), and attack, recovery, timing, model and the tone controls are MJUC settings: they come back as you left them. Mix shows WET/DRY at its ends.
No in/out: MJUC has two parameters both called Bypass.
